import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert date to datetime
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", 8)

# 1. Sales by Product (Top Left)
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
product_sales = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)
bars1 = ax1.barh(product_sales.index, product_sales.values, color=colors[:len(product_sales)])
ax1.set_xlabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Product', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Total Sales by Product', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
# Add value labels
for bar, val in zip(bars1, product_sales.values):
    ax1.text(val + 50, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, f'${val:,.0f}', 
             va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Sales by Customer Age Group (Top Right)
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
age_order = ['18-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55+']
age_sales = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().reindex(age_order)
bars2 = ax2.bar(age_sales.index, age_sales.values, color=colors[1:len(age_sales)+1], edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax2.set_xlabel('Customer Age Group', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Sales by Customer Age Group', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
# Add value labels on top of bars
for bar, val in zip(bars2, age_sales.values):
    ax2.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, val + 100, f'${val:,.0f}', 
             ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# 3. Payment Method Distribution (Bottom Left)
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
payment_counts = df['payment_method'].value_counts()
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax3.pie(payment_counts.values, labels=payment_counts.index, 
                                    autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors[2:2+len(payment_counts)],
                                    explode=[0.02]*len(payment_counts), shadow=True)
ax3.set_title('Payment Method Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
plt.setp(autotexts, size=10, weight='bold')

# 4. Average Transaction by Size and Takeaway Status (Bottom Right)
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
size_order = ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large']
df['takeaway_label'] = df['is_takeaway'].map({0: 'Dine-in', 1: 'Takeaway'})
pivot_data = df.pivot_table(values='total', index='size', columns='takeaway_label', aggfunc='mean')
pivot_data = pivot_data.reindex(size_order)

x = range(len(size_order))
width = 0.35
bars_dinein = ax4.bar([i - width/2 for i in x], pivot_data['Dine-in'], width, 
                       label='Dine-in', color=colors[4], edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5)
bars_takeaway = ax4.bar([i + width/2 for i in x], pivot_data['Takeaway'], width, 
                         label='Takeaway', color=colors[5], edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax4.set_xlabel('Size', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Average Transaction ($)', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Average Transaction by Size & Order Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xticks(x)
ax4.set_xticklabels(size_order)
ax4.legend(loc='upper left')

# Add value labels
for bars in [bars_dinein, bars_takeaway]:
    for bar in bars:
        height = bar.get_height()
        ax4.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, height + 0.1, f'${height:.2f}', 
                 ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
